entry.content: Korpus Strażników Rewolucji Islamskiej poinformował w piątek, że w cieśninie Ormuz zapaliły się i zostały zatrzymane dwa tankowce z ropą, a mediatorzy z Kataru wrócili do Teheranu na kolejną rundę rozmów mających zakończyć wojnę między Iranem a Stanami Zjednoczonymi.

entry.title: ZOO w Islamabadzie oferuje kawę z alpakami: nowa rodzinna atrakcja
entry.content: Kawa w towarzystwie alpak? W zoo pod Islamabadem goście piją kawę i jedzą przekąski, jednocześnie obserwując, karmiąc i głaszcząc dziesięć importowanych alpak – pierwszych w Pakistanie.

entry.title: Pakistan: Islamabad zoo introduces 'Coffee with Alpaca' attraction
entry.content: Coffee with a side of alpacas? At a zoo near Islamabad, visitors can enjoy drinks and snacks while watching, feeding and petting the animals. The attraction features ten imported alpacas, a first for Pakistan according to the zoo.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Russian independent newspaper Novaya Gazeta says it will shut down following pressure from Kremlin
entry.content: The paper is one of the few Russian outlets that has been openly critical of Russia's war in Ukraine, but it has come under increasing pressure from Moscow.

entry.title: Wielka Brytania bada Metę: wyzyskujące warunki dla mediów krytykowane na świecie
entry.content: Brytyjski urząd ds. konkurencji wszczął dochodzenie, czy Meta narzuca „wyzyskujące” warunki pozwalające jej używać treści medialnych, w tym dla AI, bez realnego wyboru dla wydawców.

entry.title: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard reports three tankers on fire in Strait of Hormuz as talks continue
entry.content: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard said Friday that two oil tankers had caught fire and been stopped in the Strait of Hormuz, as Qatari mediators returned to Tehran for another round of talks aimed at ending the war between Iran and the United States.

entry.title: UK probes Meta over 'exploitative' new terms for media as global pushback mounts
entry.content: Britain's competition watchdog has opened an investigation into whether Meta was imposing "exploitative" new terms allowing it to use media content for its own products, including AI, without giving publishers adequate choice.

entry.content: Ponad 2 tys. salwadorskich żołnierzy bierze udział w operacji na Haiti. Jej głównym celem jest odnalezienie czterech techników zaginionych po ataku w Port-au-Prince.

entry.title: PSG to defend Intercontinental Cup title in December as Qatar hosts final stage
entry.content: Continental champions will compete in Qatar this December as PSG seek a second successive Intercontinental Cup title. The final stages return for a third year, following earlier matches in Saudi Arabia and South Africa.

entry.title: Nvidia CEO sees Kazakhstan as potential AI hub for Europe
entry.content: During his first visit to Kazakhstan, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the country's growing computing capacity could make it a major AI hub for Europe, as Kazakhstan expands its energy and digital infrastructure.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Christa Pike describes 'pain in my mind and in my soul' in first statement after failed execution
entry.content: Pike survived two doses of pentobarbital during her attempted execution on 30 September. She was sentenced to death for torturing and killing her classmate Colleen Slemmer in 1995, when she was 18.

entry.content: Halloween has arrived at Prague Zoo, where meerkats are exploring pumpkins stuffed with worms and cheetah cubs are discovering seasonal toys. Four days of activities will bring treats to 14 animal species.

entry.title: DR Congo: MSF celebrates Ebola patient discharges in Ituri province
